contests.title: Brookhaven — senior and disabled homestead exemption

provenance.sourceOrg: DeKalb County Voter Registration and Elections
provenance.quote: Shall the Act to incorporate the City of Brookhaven be amended so as to increase the current homestead exemption for senior citizens and disabled persons from $160,000.00 to $200,000.00?

measures.questionText: Shall the Act to incorporate the City of Brookhaven be amended so as to increase the current homestead exemption for senior citizens and disabled persons from $160,000.00 to $200,000.00?

provenance.sourceOrg: DeKalb County Voter Registration and Elections
provenance.quote: Shall the Act to incorporate the City of Brookhaven be amended so as to increase the current homestead exemption for senior citizens and disabled persons from $160,000.00 to $200,000.00?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Raises Brookhaven’s special homestead exemption for qualifying senior and disabled residents from $160,000 to $200,000 of assessed home value for city property taxes. It applies to a Brookhaven resident’s homestead when the resident is disabled or qualifies as a senior; the city’s current eligibility guidance identifies seniors as age 65 or older. The existing income rule requires the resident’s income plus that of a spouse who also lives at the homestead to total no more than $15,000 for the preceding year. Assessed value above the exemption remains taxable. If voters approve, the increased exemption takes effect January 1, 2027.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the $200,000 special city-tax homestead exemption, effective January 1, 2027.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject the increase and retain the existing $160,000 special exemption.
